The Netherlands has pulled out of next year's Eurovision Song Contest, with public broadcaster NPO citing "sensitivities" over Israel's participation - reversing a previous decision to take part. New contemporary sculpture replaces the globe in the original Roman artifact with a cup as a tribute. The cup is considered one of the seven glass wonders of the world, one of just 40 glass cage cups that survived. Exactly why the unusual color effects of the Lycurgus Cup occurred was a mystery until 2007 , when a team of scientists discovered the color shifts were due to the presence of nanoparticles in the glass—the result of Roman artisans adding finely ground gold and silver into the mix. Those nanoparticles change how the electrons in the cup vibrate in response to light so that the color one sees shifts with the observer’s vantage point.

MyGolfSpy reports golfers should quit apologizing for bad shots, declining bets, or playing from shorter tees to enjoy the game without guilt. Many golfers introduce themselves with a disclaimer about their handicap before the first tee. This habit aims to lower expectations and reassure strangers of their limitations. However, the pressure to apologize for a topped drive or a three-putt is unfounded. Even the best golfers in the world simply want their playing partners to move things along. Speed of play matters more than perfect execution. A bad shot does not require a public statement or a formal apology for taking up space.

Genie 4 will roll out to developers and Google AI Ultra subscribers soon. It’s easy to look at the output of Genie 4 and see a video game, which is why Genie 3 caused so much consternation in the gaming industry. DeepMind doesn’t think about it that way, though. According to Google , world models are a key element in the march toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). A world model creates a virtual world, but it doesn’t require pre-rendering environments or programming interactive elements. You simply tell the model what you want, and it generates the experience frame by frame in real time as you explore it.

Blue marlin are typically encountered 1,000 miles south off Mexico. Michael Mackenbach hooked the 595-pound blue marlin 12 miles offshore and fought the billfish for 2.5-hours aboard a 20-foot boat. According to BD Outdoors , Mackenbach intended to release the marlin but it died during the fight. Blue marlin are more commonly found in areas off Mexico, such as Cabo San Lucas, nearly 1,000 miles south of San Pedro. Catches off Southern California are exceedingly rare in normal times, when sea-surface temperatures are significantly cooler than the mid-70s still being registered offshore.

Overcrowding and poor ventilation caused the deaths of 33 detainees in a prison cell in Minna state. An inquiry into the deaths of 33 detainees in Nigeria's Minna state has found they died as a result of severe overcrowding, poor ventilation and failure by officers to respond to distress calls. Forensic and medical evidence showed the "entirely preventable" deaths had resulted from acute respiratory failure linked to prolonged confinement, aggravated by heat stress and dehydration. The detainees were found dead on 17 September while being held by the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps on suspicion of illegal mining. The investigation found that the mining sites had been licensed.

Peter Dobing, Stoke City's captain when they won the League Cup in 1972, dies at the age of 87. Manchester-born Dobing is best remembered in the Potteries as Stoke's skipper when they lifted the trophy by beating Chelsea at Wembley in 1972. Dobing, who began his career at Blackburn Rovers, made 377 appearances and scored 95 goals for the Potters after being signed by manager Tony Waddington from Manchester City for a then club record £37,500 in 1963. At least 46 people are feared to be dead after two high-speed trains collided in Spain At least 64 people are dead after two high-speed trains collided in Spain. A government spokesperson for the Castilla La Mancha region said the two trains crashed just after 9am, causing two carriages to derail, with local authorities warning the death toll could rise. A total of 544 people were travelling on the two trains impacted by the incident, which occurred between the towns of Mora and Orgaz, and involved a Renfe and an Iryo high speed train travelling from Madrid to Seville .
